fields.name: work_entry_source
fields.help:
Defines the source for work entries generation

        Working Schedule: Work entries will be generated from the working hours below.
        Attendances: Work entries will be generated from the employee's attendances. (requires Attendance app)
        Planning: Work entries will be generated from the employee's planning. (requires Planning app)

constraints.name: _check_contract_start_date_defined
constraints.definition: CHECK(contract_date_end IS NULL OR contract_date_start IS NOT NULL)
constraints.message: The contract must have a start date.

constraints.name: _check_unique_date_version
constraints.definition: (employee_id, date_version) WHERE active = TRUE AND employee_id IS NOT NULL
constraints.message: An employee cannot have multiple active versions sharing the same effective date.
